title: Docusaurus recipe evidence loop capture plan
description: Recipe-owned capture for the Docusaurus recipe evidence demo: render the real summary, trace, manifest, and artifacts produced by the Command Center watch-and-steer capture.

load-source-artifacts.intent: Load real summary.json, trace.json, artifact-manifest.json, and recipe.json from a completed capture recipe.

render-evidence-board.intent: Render a public-safe evidence board from real artifact data, not mock fixture data.

verify-safe-view.intent: Verify the board shows summary, trace, manifest, artifact list, and no forbidden private labels.

capture-screenshot.intent: Capture the recipe evidence board as a screenshot because the proof package is static data.

publish-artifacts.intent: Publish the screenshot, source snapshot, trace, summary, and artifact manifest.
